name: ble-mac-scanner
description: Bluetooth MAC address tracking and watch health data agent. Connects to devices, tracks RSSI, and if connecting to a BPW1 watch, reads heart rate, blood oxygen levels, and blood pressure using a custom BLE protocol.

tools.name: store_and_scan
tools.description: Store a MAC address and begin Bluetooth scanning. When the target MAC is found in the scan results, it triggers a match event that the Flutter app renders as a card.

mac_address.description: The Bluetooth MAC address to watch for, e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF

tools.name: request_watch_measurement
tools.description: Send a protocol request to the connected watch to start measuring and notifying heart rate, blood oxygen (SpO2), or blood pressure.

measurement_type.description: The type of health metric to measure and read from the watch.
